headline: Corn and Wheat Hit Three-Month Lows as Soybean Prices Slide
summary: Corn and wheat investment funds hit three-month lows as a record crop in Brazil combined with a Wall Street sell-off to exert downward pressure on agricultural grains.
why: Global grain prices heavily influence agricultural sector revenues, food inflation metrics, and input costs for food producers.
why_moved: Abundant supply expectations from Brazil alongside a broad financial market sell-off pushed agricultural futures down.
